headline: PHI @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 4.47 at BOS 3.66, with a projected total of 8.13. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PHI: PHI moved -0.20 runs while BOS moved -0.64, changing the projected margin by +0.44 runs. The projected total fell -0.83, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +23.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Zack Wheeler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.0 ER over the last 3 starts. Batter research is strongest for Brandon Marsh, Jarren Duran, Trevor Story, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Trevor Story because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
